## Description
Brief summary of the changes introduced in this PR.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature for patient or staff
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `test`: Unit, bloc, golden or integration test addition
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior changes
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, CI, dependencies or flavors

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Conventional Commit format used
- [ ] Ran `flutter analyze` with 0 warnings/errors
- [ ] Ran `flutter test` and all tests pass
- [ ] Tested with Firebase Emulator Suite
- [ ] Both English and Swahili translations provided for any new user-facing copy
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or medical data stored or committed
